info.name: Rallye Auth 2A — web cookies + CSRF
info.description: Manual local development tests matching AuthController. See docs/authentication-2a.md. Enable cookie jar; allowlist localhost for scripts. Collection variables have no real secrets. Fill password/newPassword/resetNewPassword locally. Activation/reset tokens must be copied from local mailbox; never commit/export populated secrets. Run requests individually in numbered order, pausing to fill tokens. No Authorization or mobile headers: web cookie flow. password is updated after successful password change/reset. Error folder is optional and state-dependent. Administration 3b.1 is in folder 05; manual SQL bootstrap is required first. See docs/administration-3b1.md. No actual credentials are included.

item.name: 09 — Manual ADMIN change of existing crew captain
item.description: Standalone manual scenario. Does not create or delete a crew. Use an existing crew owned by ordinary user A and active verified target user B, while logged in as ADMIN. Keep original request version and key for replay.

request.description: Manual ADMIN transfer from ordinary user A to ordinary user B. First log in as ADMIN (3b2 15 Login administrator or 18 Login administrator). Set crewId to an existing crew owned by A; GET its detail and copy version to crewCaptainChangeVersion. Set newCaptainAccountId to the internal UUID of active, email-verified user B, different from A. The original captain ID is read by the server, not supplied by this request. Cookie jar and inherited collection CSRF script remain active. crewCaptainChangeKey is generated once if empty. Repeat unchanged key, crewId, target and request version for idempotent replay. For another independent change, clear the key and set a fresh version from GET detail. A stale version returns 409 CREW_VERSION_CONFLICT; changed parameters with the same key return 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; the same current captain with a new key returns 409 CAPTAIN_UNCHANGED.

exec: throw new Error('Set crewId, newCaptainAccountId (UUIDs), and crewCaptainChangeVersion from GET crew detail. Log in as ADMIN first.');

item.name: 10 — Crew transfers 3b.3b
item.description: Creation/resend for captain transfers. See folder 11 for decisions and safeguards implemented in 3b.3c. Inherited cookie/CSRF handling remains active. Use original keys for replay; never export populated tokens.

request.description: Set target email and current crew version. 201 and one email; preserve key and version for replay. Clear key only for a new independent operation.

if(!pm.collectionVariables.get('crewTransferTargetEmail') || !/^[0-9]+$/.test(pm.collectionVariables.get('crewTransferVersion')||'')) {pm.execution.skipRequest();throw new Error('Set crewTransferTargetEmail and crewTransferVersion from GET crew detail.');}
pm.test('No token or hash in response',()=>{const b=pm.response.text();pm.expect(b).not.to.match(/token|token_hash|tokenHash/i);});
